deterministic_evidence.dry_run_replay_requirement: two independent dry-run output directories must have byte-identical eight payload files and byte-identical evidence ZIPs
deterministic_evidence.zip_entries: the eight required output files, sorted by filename

dry_run_profile.purpose: path/shape/determinism validation only; all numerical OC results are non-binding

hard_gate_implementation.candidate_pass: stream-level + combined-stream + stream-stability must all pass

combined_stream_level.pooling: pool binomial success/trial counts across A and B for matching N/stress/estimand/family

hard_gate_implementation.n40_rule: if diagnostic selected candidate is 40, feasibility decision is required before any formal-N freeze
hard_gate_implementation.selection: smallest passing frozen candidate when selection is enabled

stream_level.coverage: each stream x each stress must satisfy mean >= 0.945 and minimum estimand >= 0.930
stream_level.null_fwer: each stream x each stress x each family must satisfy point <= 0.055 and Wilson95 upper <= 0.060
stream_level.power: each stream at 1.0x must satisfy every active d=0.80 estimand point >= 0.800 and Wilson95 lower >= 0.780

stream_stability.family_fwer: maximum matched |A-B| across stress x family <= 0.015

loo_contract.effect_anchor: single-signal d=0.80 uses the full-five-block baseline sample SD, not the leave-one-out SD
loo_contract.residual_library: recenter the remaining four block residual vectors column-wise after omission
loo_contract.seed_derivation: same SHA256 first-8-byte big-endian derivation as primary cells

purpose.goal: Complete and validate the full offline OC executor using a non-binding reduced-iteration dry-run before the frozen 20,000/5,000 calibration is allowed to execute.

simulation_engine.dense_optimization: shift all estimand means by 0.50 x full-five-block baseline SD; SDs unchanged
primary_rng_draw_order: draw complete iterations x N row-index array
draw complete iterations x N sign-bit array
process those frozen arrays in chunks without additional RNG calls
simulation_engine.single_signal_optimization: shift the active estimand mean only; reuse null means/SDs and null p-values for inactive coordinates
